observation_summary: The getLInfNorm() method in both ArrayRealVector and OpenMapRealVector incorrectly calculates the L-infinity norm by accumulating values instead of finding the maximum absolute value.
hypothesis: The getLInfNorm() method in both ArrayRealVector and OpenMapRealVector contains an incorrect implementation of the L-infinity norm calculation.
